name: Flamebait Dating Sim! Developing games! (and feelings?)
source:
Welcome to the Flame Jam™, the biggest and most prestigious game jam of the year, hosted in mumble, Sweden! You, lucky participant, have been selected to join the (surprisingly handsome, charming, and single) hosts from Flamebait and jam with them!

You’ve got the skills to work whatever field you want, so take some time to get to know the Flamebaes and decide how you’re gonna spend this jam!

[From [url=https://rottenraccoons.itch.io/flamebait-dating-sim-developing-games-and-feelings]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到Flame Jam™，这是在瑞典曼布尔举办的年度规模最大、最负盛名的游戏比赛！你，幸运的参与者，已被选中加入来自Flamebait的（令人惊讶的英俊、迷人、单身）主持人并与他们一起即兴表演！

你拥有从事任何你想要从事的领域的技能，所以花一些时间来了解Flamebaes，并决定你将如何度过这个果酱！

[来自[url=https://rottenraccoons.itch.io/flamebait-dating-sim-developing-games-and-feelings]itch.io[/url]]
